summary: BlackRock Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 676,246 Institutional Class shares for $15.9M under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, and declared a regular quarterly distribution of $0.1772 per share across Institutional, Class S, and Class D shares, payable on August 27, 2026 to holders of record July 30, 2026. The filing also disclosed NAV per share of $23.49 as of June 30, 2026. This is a routine capital raise and distribution announcement by a BDC. No merger, tender, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation is present. A normal periodic update with no event-driven arbitrage angle.
